nom: Banila Co Snoopy Edition Clean it Zero Original Cleansing Balm

avis.titre: Doesn't irritate my eyes and removes everything
avis.texte: This cleansing balm removes SPF and long-wearing makeup. I get no eye irritation, which I've experienced with other brands. I use a separate eye makeup remover for waterproof mascara, and need to do this with any cleansing balm. I'll buy this again!
